nativeBaseline.reference: transient informational or interactive preview; choose semantics according to content

library: Preserve keyboard/pointer access, hover persistence and dismissal; define interactive content focus policy.
consumer: Author meaningful preview and trigger content; choose informational or interactive use.

notes: Native manual popover preserves pointer and focus access across the trigger and preview, dismisses on Escape, and restores trigger focus only when closing from content. Preserve native trigger navigation.

Informational previews have no interactive controls. Interactive previews must expose authored semantics and keyboard access; do not autofocus on hover or trap focus. Use Popover/Dialog for explicit activation or focus-transfer intent.
Audit mapping is provisional; not a conformance claim.
